To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) We propose a novel attention scheme for multi-horizon forecasting that allows the model to learn a context-dependent seasonality function, and that can be used to improve the accuracy of the model.

(i) a novel decoder-attention scheme improves accuracy of probabilistic forecasts, (ii) a novel positional encoding allows the network to learn context dependent seasonality and holiday distances, and (iii) a novel feedback-aware decoder self attention scheme reduces excess variability of the forecast.

(a) the proposed attention mechanism improves accuracy by 0.5% to 1.5%, (b) the proposed positional encoding improves accuracy by 1.5% to nearly 3%, (c) the proposed decoder-self attention improves accuracy by 2%, and (d) the proposed decoder-encoder attention improves accuracy by more than 2%
